title: Apsis - a small demo of my alien horror/survival game
author: Zenpher
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I've been working on **Apsis**, a first-person horror/survival game that runs completely in the browser. There's nothing to install, and the first demo is playable now at [https://apsis.formandelement.com/](https://apsis.formandelement.com/)

The premise:

>It's 1979. You wake up inside a crashed ship between the Russian/Chinese border. You're being hunted by mysterious beings.

I would appreciate any feedback you would have, especially around:

* performance (I recommend a dedicated GPU or apple silicon)
* where it scared you and where it didn't
* any bugs you hit
* thoughts on gameplay mechanics
* 🎮controller support (natively works with dualsense in Chrome!)

Please keep in mind this is just a basic demo to try things out. It's pretty linear and it's missing a lot of mechanics. I do have a multiplayer survival build I'm testing out, I'll post more updates on that soon.

Thank you for playing :)
